messages:
maria: quick idea after the canary — instead of per-tenant durable slabs only, what if we support tiny route-level micro-reservations keyed by prompt-fingerprint? helps low-latency routes that are heavy hitters without giving every tenant a slab.

alex: interesting. so we'd fingerprint by route+prompt-hash bucket and keep a 1-2 slot reservation for that bucket? what about churn when prompts drift?

maria: yep. map: fingerprint -> reservation {slots, last_seen_ts}. rightsize by 24h p95 of requests for that fingerprint. eviction when idle > 6h. keep total micro-reservations bounded by pool fraction.

jordan: a few concerns: (1) attack surface — someone could craft many unique prompts to bloat reservation table, (2) accounting + fairness vs tenant slabs.

kevin: on (1) we should limit unique fingerprint count per tenant and per-shard. also require a min-requests threshold before promoting to a reservation.

maria: good. promotion flow: request_count_windowed >= promotion_threshold -> attempt_reservation (atomic check vs region_budget). if fail, keep using burst tokens.

jordan: admission flow sketch: 1) check durable slab 2) check route-micro-reservation 3) use regional burst tokens 4) queue/probe. include path in traces.

kevin: config snippet proposal:
```yaml
micro_reserve:
  promotion_threshold: 50
  min_slots: 1
  max_slots_per_fp: 2
  eviction_idle_s: 21600
  region_max_fraction: 0.05
```

alex: rollout idea: enable micro-reserve behind flag for 5 high-traffic routes in staging, monitor metric: micro_resv_active, micro_resv_promotions, promotion_rejects, coldstart_p95_by_route.

maria: ops: operator should expose endpoints to list & evict fingerprints; eviction should be graceful (mark draining, wait lease TTL). orch-bot can post eviction summaries.

orch-bot: note: operator v0.11 will add event: MicroResvPromoted tenant=<t> fp=<hash> slots=1

jordan: tests: unit for promotion logic + stress test that simulates 10k unique prompts to ensure per-tenant cap holds. integration: canary with synthetic client that repeats a hot prompt and bursty others.

kevin: sounds actionable. i'll prototype promotion circuit and a tiny in-memory fingerprint cache for autoscaler. maria will draft RFC addendum with rollout checklist.

maria: thanks — i'll track owners and open PRs. tagging: @kevin (prototype), @maria (RFC), @alex (canary telemetry). will update here. :thumbsup:
